title: Availability Summary
description: Summary availability when detailed destination-level inventory is unavailable, undisclosed, or unnecessary.

available.description: Whether the item or method is available under the applied context and filters.

status.description: Availability status. Well-known values: in_stock, limited_stock, backorder, preorder, out_of_stock, discontinued, unavailable, unknown.

description.description: Buyer-facing summary of the availability result.

destination_count.description: Number of buyer-visible destinations represented by this summary, when the business chooses to disclose it.
